history.summary: A 1,300 sqft 999-yr leasehold (quasi-freehold) 4BR walk-up apartment in D05 Pasir Panjang at $2.0M / $1,538 PSF, 460m from Pasir Panjang MRT. Walk-up (no lift/facilities) and no URA data are the swing factors against an otherwise well-located One-North-adjacent asset.
history.rating_rationale: 999-yr tenure is effectively freehold and $2.0M for a 1,300 sqft unit in D05 near One-North / Greater Southern Waterfront has a real catalyst angle; 460m to Pasir Panjang CCL MRT and score_1000 607 support it. But a walk-up apartment (no lift, no condo facilities, likely older with no built year) has a narrower buyer pool and weaker rental premium than a full-facility condo, and there's no URA data to confirm appreciation. Catalyst-rich location, but the walk-up format caps the case.
red_flags: Walk-up apartment — no lift/facilities, narrower buyer pool
No built year and no URA appreciation/txn data
Walk-ups can carry en-bloc/redevelopment uncertainty and higher upkeep
catalysts: D05 Pasir Panjang near One-North tech hub and Greater Southern Waterfront transformation
460m (6 min) to Pasir Panjang CCL MRT
